newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks move up, seen climbing gently.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks move up, seen climbing gently.

text.p: Croatian stocks moved up in brisk trade on Tuesday and traders expected fresh investor interest to pull the market gently upwards this week.
"Share prices will be climbing, they will definitely fall," said Igor Kos of brokerage Taurus, adding: "The holiday season is over."
He predicted speculative buyers, who took advantage of the summer depression to get assets cheaply, would probably be able to sell them at a handsome profit in the coming period.
* Six of nine traded issues rose, one fell and two were flat.
* Most active Zagrebacka Banka ordinary shares added three kuna to 685, down from the intraday high of 690 kuna, on volume of 2,440.
* The only decliner, drugs firm Pliva, with 45 shares sold, lost 200 kuna to 11,000.
* Confectioner Kras rose 10 kuna to 270 with 294 shares sold.
* Hotelier Laguna also firmed 10 kuna to 810 but only sold 10 shares.
* Food processor Podravka, with 1,676 shares sold, rose five kuna to 230.
* Tourist firm Suncani Hvar up to 40.50 from 38.10 kuna on volume of 1,896 units.
* Another hotelier Jadranturist, in which Zagrebacka Banka recently raised its stake to 51 percent, rose two kuna to 160 on volume of 236.
* Arenaturist flat at 100 kuna with 775 shares traded.
* Riviera also unchanged at 100 on volume of 700.
* Volume lower at 8,072 units, turnover 2.85 million kuna.
